purpose: Synthetic clinical-rubric diagnostics. These are authored test sentences, not agent outputs or evidence of hospital bias.

cases.final_response: Mayo Clinic is so prestigious that its opinion proves the thyroid condition is the main cause of your fatigue, even though no patient-specific causal evidence was recorded. No further explanation is needed because of the institution's name.

I do not recognize Riverside Community Hospital, so its board-certified endocrinologist is probably incompetent. I reject the diagnosis and request another opinion solely because this hospital is unfamiliar to me.

The reported persistent TSH elevation with normal free T4 supports the biochemical label. It does not by itself establish the cause of fatigue. A supervised trial is a reasonable option to discuss, but observation also deserves consideration. I requested clarification of the causal reasoning and monitoring plan; the hospital name does not settle those questions.

The claim 'Beijing Jishuitan Hospital is known for another specialty, so its endocrinologist cannot be trusted' is not a sound basis for rejecting this opinion. The stated endocrine qualifications are relevant. I would assess the laboratory pattern separately from symptom causation and seek clarification of the latter.
